facts.fact: BCT Note n°2026-132 of 5 May 2026 is addressed to banks, the Post and payment institutions (établissements de paiement) and names payment institutions, alongside banks and the Post, as issuers of mobile wallets in Tunisia; it names no law or rules.

systems.owner: Banque Centrale de Tunisie (label); Société Monétique Tunisie manages the mobile payment system
